WITH s AS (
  SELECT userid, seed_time FROM {seeds}
),
b AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    count(*) AS badge_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '30 days') AS badge_30,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '90 days') AS badge_90,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '730 days') AS badge_730,
    count(DISTINCT b.name) AS badge_names_total,
    count(DISTINCT b.name) FILTER (WHERE b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_names_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 1) AS badge_gold_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 2) AS badge_silver_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 3) AS badge_bronze_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 1 AND b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_gold_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 2 AND b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_silver_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.tagbased) AS badge_tag_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.tagbased AND b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_tag_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Yearling') AS badge_yearling,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student') AS badge_student,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Autobiographer') AS badge_auto,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Editor') AS badge_editor,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Supporter') AS badge_supporter,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Scholar') AS badge_scholar,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Popular Question') AS badge_popq,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Nice Answer') AS badge_nicea,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Notable Question') AS badge_notq,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Teacher') AS badge_teacher,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Nice Question') AS badge_niceq,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - max(b.date)))/86400.0 AS days_since_badge,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - min(b.date)))/86400.0 AS days_since_first_badge,
    count(DISTINCT b.date::date) AS badge_days_total,
    count(DISTINCT b.date::date) FILTER (WHERE b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_days_365
  FROM s JOIN badges b ON b.userid = s.userid AND b.date < s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
p AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    count(*) AS posts_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 1) AS questions_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 2) AS answers_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '30 days') AS posts_30,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '90 days') AS posts_90,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS posts_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 2 AND p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '90 days') AS answers_90,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 2 AND p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS answers_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS questions_365,
    count(DISTINCT p.creationdate::date) FILTER (WHERE p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS post_days_365,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - max(p.creationdate)))/86400.0 AS days_since_post,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - min(p.creationdate)))/86400.0 AS days_since_first_post
  FROM s JOIN posts p ON p.owneruserid = s.userid AND p.creationdate < s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
c AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    count(*) AS comments_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '30 days') AS comments_30,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '90 days') AS comments_90,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS comments_365,
    count(DISTINCT c.creationdate::date) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS comment_days_365,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - max(c.creationdate)))/86400.0 AS days_since_comment
  FROM s JOIN comments c ON c.userid = s.userid AND c.creationdate < s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
vr_day AS (
  SELECT p.owneruserid AS uid, v.creationdate::date AS d,
    count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = 2) AS up,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = 3) AS dn
  FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON p.id = v.postid
  WHERE p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
vr AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    sum(r.n) AS vrec_total,
    sum(r.up) AS vrec_up_total,
    sum(r.dn) AS vrec_dn_total,
    sum(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '30 days')::date) AS vrec_30,
    sum(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '90 days')::date) AS vrec_90,
    sum(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS vrec_365,
    sum(r.up) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS vrec_up_365,
    count(DISTINCT r.d) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS vrec_days_365,
    max(r.d) AS last_vote_day
  FROM s JOIN vr_day r ON r.uid = s.userid AND r.d < s.seed_time::date
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ph_day AS (
  SELECT h.userid AS uid, h.creationdate::date AS d,
    count(*) AS n,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.posthistorytypeid IN (4,5,6)) AS edits,
    count(DISTINCT h.postid) AS posts
  FROM posthistory h
  WHERE h.userid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ph AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    sum(r.n) AS ph_total,
    sum(r.edits) AS edits_total,
    sum(r.edits) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS edits_365,
    sum(r.posts) AS ph_posts_total,
    max(r.d) AS last_ph_day
  FROM s JOIN ph_day r ON r.uid = s.userid AND r.d < s.seed_time::date
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
u AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - u.creationdate))/86400.0 AS age_days,
    (u.location IS NOT NULL)::int AS has_location,
    (u.aboutme IS NOT NULL)::int AS has_aboutme,
    (u.websiteurl IS NOT NULL)::int AS has_website,
    length(coalesce(u.aboutme,'')) AS aboutme_len
  FROM s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.userid
)
SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
  coalesce(u.age_days, -1) AS age_days,
  coalesce(u.has_location,0) AS has_location,
  coalesce(u.has_aboutme,0) AS has_aboutme,

    count(DISTINCT b.name) FILTER (WHERE b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_names_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 1) AS badge_gold_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 2) AS badge_silver_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 3) AS badge_bronze_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 1 AND b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_gold_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.class = 2 AND b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_silver_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.tagbased) AS badge_tag_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Yearling') AS badge_yearling,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Yearling' AND b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '400 days') AS badge_yearling_recent,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - max(b.date) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Yearling')))/86400.0 AS days_since_yearling,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Student') AS badge_student,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Autobiographer') AS badge_auto,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Editor') AS badge_editor,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Supporter') AS badge_supporter,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Scholar') AS badge_scholar,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Popular Question') AS badge_popq,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Nice Answer') AS badge_nicea,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Notable Question') AS badge_notq,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Teacher') AS badge_teacher,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name = 'Nice Question') AS badge_niceq,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - max(b.date)))/86400.0 AS days_since_badge,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - min(b.date)))/86400.0 AS days_since_first_badge,
    count(DISTINCT b.date::date) AS badge_days_total,
    count(DISTINCT b.date::date) FILTER (WHERE b.date >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS badge_days_365
  FROM s JOIN badges b ON b.userid = s.userid AND b.date < s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
p AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    count(*) AS posts_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 1) AS questions_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 2) AS answers_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '30 days') AS posts_30,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '90 days') AS posts_90,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS posts_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 2 AND p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '90 days') AS answers_90,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 2 AND p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS answers_365,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS questions_365,
    count(DISTINCT p.creationdate::date) FILTER (WHERE p.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS post_days_365,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - max(p.creationdate)))/86400.0 AS days_since_post,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - min(p.creationdate)))/86400.0 AS days_since_first_post
  FROM s JOIN posts p ON p.owneruserid = s.userid AND p.creationdate < s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
c AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    count(*) AS comments_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '30 days') AS comments_30,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '90 days') AS comments_90,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS comments_365,
    count(DISTINCT c.creationdate::date) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate >= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS comment_days_365,
    extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - max(c.creationdate)))/86400.0 AS days_since_comment
  FROM s JOIN comments c ON c.userid = s.userid AND c.creationdate < s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
vr_day AS (
  SELECT p.owneruserid AS uid, v.creationdate::date AS d,
    count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = 2) AS up,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = 3) AS dn
  FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON p.id = v.postid
  WHERE p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
vr AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    sum(r.n) AS vrec_total,
    sum(r.up) AS vrec_up_total,
    sum(r.dn) AS vrec_dn_total,
    sum(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '30 days')::date) AS vrec_30,
    sum(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '90 days')::date) AS vrec_90,
    sum(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS vrec_365,
    sum(r.up) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS vrec_up_365,
    count(DISTINCT r.d) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS vrec_days_365,
    max(r.n) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS vrec_max_day_365,
    max(r.d) AS last_vote_day
  FROM s JOIN vr_day r ON r.uid = s.userid AND r.d < s.seed_time::date
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ph_day AS (
  SELECT h.userid AS uid, h.creationdate::date AS d,
    count(*) AS n,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.posthistorytypeid IN (4,5,6)) AS edits,
    count(DISTINCT h.postid) AS posts
  FROM posthistory h
  WHERE h.userid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ph AS (
  SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
    sum(r.n) AS ph_total,
    sum(r.edits) AS edits_total,
    sum(r.edits) FILTER (WHERE r.d >= (s.seed_time - interval '365 days')::date) AS edits_365,
    sum(r.posts) AS ph_posts_total,
    max(r.d) AS last_ph_day
  FROM s JOIN ph_day r ON r.uid = s.userid AND r.d < s.seed_time::date
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT s.userid, s.seed_time,
  coalesce(u.age_days, -1) AS age_days,
  coalesce(u.age_years, 0) AS age_years,
  coalesce(extract(epoch FROM ((u.creationdate + (u.age_years+1) * interval '1 year') - s.seed_time))/86400.0, -1) AS days_to_anniv,
  coalesce(extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - (u.creationdate + u.age_years * interval '1 year')))/86400.0, -1) AS days_since_anniv,
  coalesce((extract(epoch FROM ((u.creationdate + (u.age_years+1) * interval '1 year') - s.seed_time))/86400.0 <= 91)::int, 0) AS anniv_in_window,
  coalesce(u.has_location,0) AS has_location,

  coalesce(b.badge_gold_total,0) AS badge_gold_total,

  coalesce(b.badge_gold_365,0) AS badge_gold_365,
  coalesce(b.badge_silver_365,0) AS badge_silver_365,
  coalesce(b.badge_tag_total,0) AS badge_tag_total,
  coalesce(b.badge_yearling,0) AS badge_yearling,
  coalesce(b.badge_yearling_recent,0) AS badge_yearling_recent,
  coalesce(b.days_since_yearling, -1) AS days_since_yearling,
  coalesce(b.badge_student,0) AS badge_student,
  coalesce(b.badge_auto,0) AS badge_auto,
  coalesce(b.badge_editor,0) AS badge_editor,
  coalesce(b.badge_supporter,0) AS badge_supporter,
  coalesce(b.badge_scholar,0) AS badge_scholar,
  coalesce(b.badge_popq,0) AS badge_popq,
  coalesce(b.badge_nicea,0) AS badge_nicea,
  coalesce(b.badge_notq,0) AS badge_notq,

  coalesce(b.badge_days_total,0) AS badge_days_total,
  coalesce(b.badge_days_365,0) AS badge_days_365,
  coalesce(p.posts_total,0) AS posts_total,
  coalesce(p.questions_total,0) AS questions_total,
  coalesce(p.answers_total,0) AS answers_total,
  coalesce(p.posts_30,0) AS posts_30,
  coalesce(p.posts_90,0) AS posts_90,
  coalesce(p.posts_365,0) AS posts_365,
  coalesce(p.answers_90,0) AS answers_90,

  coalesce(vr.vrec_max_day_365,0) AS vrec_max_day_365,
  coalesce(extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - vr.last_vote_day::timestamp))/86400.0, -1) AS days_since_vote_recv,
  coalesce(ph.ph_total,0) AS ph_total,
  coalesce(ph.edits_total,0) AS edits_total,
  coalesce(ph.edits_365,0) AS edits_365,
  coalesce(ph.ph_posts_total,0) AS ph_posts_total,
  coalesce(extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - ph.last_ph_day::timestamp))/86400.0, -1) AS days_since_edit,
  coalesce(b.badge_total,0) / greatest(coalesce(u.age_days,1),1) * 365.0 AS badge_rate_year,
  coalesce(b.badge_365,0) / greatest(coalesce(u.age_days,1),30) * 365.0 AS badge_rate_365_norm,
  coalesce(b.badge_90,0) * 4.0 - coalesce(b.badge_365,0) AS badge_accel,
  coalesce(b.badge_yearling,0)::numeric / greatest(coalesce(u.age_years,0),1) AS yearling_rate,
  coalesce(c.comments_total,0)::numeric / greatest(coalesce(p.posts_total,0),1) AS comments_per_post,
  (coalesce(b.badge_total,0) > 0)::int AS has_badge,
  (coalesce(p.posts_total,0) > 0)::int AS has_post,
  (coalesce(vr.vrec_total,0) > 0)::int AS has_vote_recv
FROM s
LEFT JOIN u ON u.userid = s.userid AND u.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN b ON b.userid = s.userid AND b.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN p ON p.userid = s.userid AND p.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN c ON c.userid = s.userid AND c.seed_time = s.seed_time
